title: 第三十二章 从龙之功
slug: 纨绔女修四处撩绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
施源嘴角扯开弧度，眼里却没有丝毫笑意。

“想清楚了。大小姐强抢乐修，乐修拼死反抗，狼妖护主命丧当场，可真是感天动地啊。”

“本城主鞭长莫及，去得迟了，真是可惜了。”

萧姚还抱着苍岚，只能敷衍地鼓鼓掌：

“故事编得不错，等秦公子变成秦谷主之后，你去当说书先生，应该饿不死。”

“呃，居然会是这样。那你能不能给我介绍一下这件法器呢？”李乘好奇的问道。

但是，当着广场八大宗门五千弟子的面，为了冲宵门的颜面和声誉，他只能忍。

这些经常来这里的人，那几乎都是闲着无聊，到处寻求刺激的人，这些人都是唯恐天下不乱的主，有时候没有事情他们还会找点事情取乐，现在有事情发生，他们更是兴奋的火上浇油，希望把事情搞得更大。

反正这对父子仗着自己手中的权利，也没少给自己暗中使绊子，如果没有记错的话，自己那便宜父亲所留给自己的生意，就是被眼前两人一点点吞吃掉的。

叶寒看着眼前那栋十分宏伟的建筑物，不由得心生一股豪迈之意，这建筑物是全京州城最高的一栋，看起来是那样的霸气威压。

“宇哥，我们出去了。你就在这里修炼。把这舍利子和诛仙剑中的能量，都给吸收干净了。看看能不能冲击大罗金仙。”清影对凌渡宇道。在她们眼中，凌渡宇跨越大罗仙的境界，还是很容易的事情。

“真是个怪胎，就是不知道在总院之中，你又将掀起怎么巨大的风波呢！”最后，萧长歌只是摇摇头，灌了口梨花落，走入梨园。

只是那门板阔剑也散发着浓烈的道威，只怕已经成为叶芊芊的本命神兵，路线也都已经定下了，根本不可能再更改了。

天生走到近前，仔细端详着，糕点看起来极为精致。随意拿了一块，凑到鼻间轻轻嗅了嗅，一股清香扑面而来，勾人食欲。

一指之后，天地间唯剩下那轻微的风声还在作响，下面聚集的混沌凶兽却是早已没了声响，转眼间便已倒了一地，冥河一伸手，无数混沌本源便汇聚到了他的手心之中，有一挥袖，所有混沌凶兽的尸体都尽数被他受了起来。

“什么事？你现在可以问。”叶蓁蓁着急的神色都表现在脸上。

南建国约见叶蓁蓁的茶室，离蓁蓁的住处新城公寓很近，蓁蓁背着包走了十来分钟就到了新城公寓楼下。

此时地面的晃动越来越轻，空中的空间裂缝也开始少了起来。突然一种危险的感觉涌上众人心头，众人顾不得还在时隐时现的空间裂缝，都施展全力向空中飞去。

“是的。以前那个偷渡客一直也在为我们工作，就把这两个傻子也介绍来了。”楚睿说道。

不过西萝并不急着切直播，因为在切入直播之前，西萝想悄悄的去办点私事儿。

蜉蝣一梦可是一个不落的全都捡了，开始他还不相信自己能全捡，后来干脆开了自己的手机，在电脑边上录下来。

萧隐登时感到一股绵绵不断的巨力突然从对面狂涌而来，犹如大海中的层层巨浪在连绵不绝地拍打海岸。

听到这话，大家的目光齐刷刷都聚向了立在艾娜身后不远处的紫中白。

“去哪儿？”自前天她无意说错话，她们之间便冷了下来。一个别扭不好意思道歉，一个话少不懂解释。今儿他兴致冲冲打扮一新，还给她穿漂亮衣服，很疑惑，很好奇。
content_en:
The corners of Shi Yuan's mouth curled up, but there was no smile in his eyes.

"Think clearly. The eldest lady robbed Le Xiu, Le Xiu resisted desperately, and the wolf demon protector died on the spot. It was really touching."

"The city lord is beyond our reach and it's a pity that we arrived late."

Xiao Yao was still holding Cang Lan and could only applaud perfunctorily:

"The story is well written. When Mr. Qin becomes the master of Qin Valley, you will be a storyteller and you won't die of hunger."

"Well, that's how it is. Then can you introduce this magical weapon to me?" Li Cheng asked curiously.

However, in front of the five thousand disciples of the eight major sects in the square, he could only endure it for the sake of Chongxiao Sect's face and reputation.

These people who often come here are almost all idle and bored people, looking for excitement everywhere. These people are afraid of the world being unstable. Sometimes they will find something to have fun when nothing happens. Now that something happens, they are even more excited and add fuel to the fire, hoping to make things bigger.

Anyway, the father and son relied on the power in their hands, and they secretly made trouble for themselves. If I remember correctly, the business left to me by my cheap father was eaten up bit by bit by the two people in front of me.

Ye Han looked at the very majestic building in front of him and couldn't help but feel a sense of heroism. This building was the tallest building in Jingzhou City, and it looked so domineering and coercive.

"Brother Yu, we are out. You practice here. Absorb all the energy in this relic and the Zhuxian Sword. See if you can attack Da Luo Jinxian." Qingying said to Ling Duyu.In their eyes, it was easy for Ling Duyu to cross the realm of Daluo Immortal.

"What a freak. I just don't know what kind of huge disturbance you will cause in the main hospital!" In the end, Xiao Changge just shook his head, took a sip of Li Hua Luo, and walked into the pear garden.

But the broad sword on the door panel also exudes strong authority. It may have become Ye Qianqian's natal weapon, and the route has been set, and it is impossible to change it.

Tiansheng walked closer and looked at it carefully. The pastries looked extremely delicate.I took a piece at random, put it to my nose and sniffed it gently, and a refreshing fragrance hit me, which aroused my appetite.

After one finger, only the slight sound of wind was still sounding in the world, but the chaotic beasts gathered below had long since made no sound. In the blink of an eye, they had fallen to the ground. Styx stretched out his hand, and countless chaos origins gathered in the palm of his hand. With a wave of his sleeve, all the corpses of the chaotic beasts were picked up by him.

"What's the matter? You can ask now." Ye Zhenzhen's anxious look was reflected on her face.

The tea room where Nan Jianguo met Ye Zhenzhen was very close to Zhenzhen's residence, Xincheng Apartment. Zhenzhen walked for about ten minutes with her bag on her back and arrived at the downstairs of Xincheng Apartment.

At this time, the shaking of the ground became lighter and lighter, and the space cracks in the air began to decrease.Suddenly, a feeling of danger surged into everyone's hearts. Everyone ignored the space cracks that were still appearing and disappearing, and flew into the air with all their strength.

"Yes. The stowaway had been working for us before, so he introduced these two fools." Chu Rui said.

However, Xiluo was not in a hurry to switch to the live broadcast, because before switching to the live broadcast, Xiluo wanted to do some personal things quietly.

Mayfly Yimeng picked up every single one of them. At first he didn't believe that he could pick them all, but later he turned on his cell phone and recorded it next to the computer.

Xiao Yin immediately felt a continuous and huge force suddenly surge from the opposite side, like layers of huge waves in the sea continuously lapping at the coast.

Hearing this, everyone's eyes were all focused on Zhongbai, who was standing not far behind Aina.

"Where are you going?" Since she accidentally said the wrong thing the day before yesterday, things have become cold between them.One is awkward and embarrassed to apologize, while the other is too short to explain.Today he dressed up happily and gave her beautiful clothes. She was very confused and curious.
